gaps: Not a complete roll-call census: all confidence/no-confidence motions, all budget readings/reservations and dissenters remain to be enumerated from official protocols.
Coalition agreements/signing dates and statutory effective dates of resignation letters have not been comprehensively recovered.
Official database membership transitions establish faction composition, not the exact legal decision type; committee protocols remain required.
Replacement reasons and candidate succession chains remain unknown in the referenced membership dataset; do not infer Norwegian-law exits, ordinary resignations or deaths from dates alone.
English contemporary reports predominate in this pass; Hebrew primary documents and trusted institutional scholarship remain to be added.
2023 emergency-government approval: 66–4 versus 66–0 reports; official roll call required.
2023 revised budget opposition tally: Globes/Jerusalem Post 44 versus another contemporary report 45; verify official tally.

2024 second supplementary budget final vote remains an indexed lead; the third supplementary budget on 24 December is now corroborated by a readable contemporary report, with separate framework/budget vote IDs still needed.
20 May 2026 preliminary dissolution: 110–0 indexed in i24 report, but full text not recovered; final legal instrument also needed.
Full Shas ministerial resignation chronology (announcement, submission, effective date, Arbel exception) and later formal coalition status unresolved.

2026 election day is 27 October in inspected dissolution reports. The 26th Knesset inaugural sitting is announced for 10 November (future as of this report); do not mark 25th Knesset membership ended on election day.
No exhaustive proof of no further party exits/returns after July 2025; Eichler arrangement shows why ordinary vote support cannot prove a whole-party return.
Maoz completed reinstatement authenticated in 28 May 2023 press report. Arbel second resignation authenticated in 20 July 2025 report; statutory effective dates still need primary notices.

IDI winter-session review establishes nine no-confidence motions in winter 2023–24 and 26 in summer 2023. These totals demonstrate that this dataset is incomplete; do not treat the collected subset as the complete vote universe.
Revised 2023 budget: Reshet 13 gives 58–45, alongside 59–44 and 59–45 reports. Both for and against totals remain unresolved.

method.classification: Editorial application of the brief, independent of factual certainty. counts includes faction-only and vote-only events; consult timelineViews and supportEffect before changing support colours.
method.sourceAccess: Managed web search/open, plus retained official repository records. No access-control circumvention. Tool-controlled web User-Agent is not exposed; direct HTTP retrieval must use the project User-Agent.
method.sourceAccounting: Distinct canonical URLs and publisher families can be counted from events[].sources. No claim of independent corroboration from repeated reports by one publisher.
method.membershipReferences: All existing replacement rows indexed by JSON Pointer; no duplicated replacement pairings or invented reasons. Reference rows are excluded from classification totals.
method.resumeNote: Post-restart pass preserved original commit; added completed office/accord milestones and vote evidence. Official indexed session leads remain outside counted events.
